pairs.target: ài kē názǒu tǎ wéi de qiānbǐ ,
pairs.english: Eko took Tavi's pencil away,
pairs.hanzi: 艾珂拿走塔维的铅笔，

pairs.target: shuō tā zài qiāoxiàqù , zhěngjiān wūzi dōu yào yǐwéi jìshí yǐjīng kāishǐ .
pairs.english: saying that if he kept tapping, the whole room would think the timing had begun.
pairs.hanzi: 说他再敲下去，整间屋子都要以为计时已经开始。

pairs.target: tā zhè cái bǎshǒu fàng píng .
pairs.english: Only then did he lay his hands flat.
pairs.hanzi: 他这才把手放平。

pairs.target: chuāngtáishàng bǎi zhe liǎngtào zhǔnbèi hǎo de tiěpiàn ,
pairs.english: Two prepared sets of iron plates stood on the windowsill,
pairs.hanzi: 窗台上摆着两套准备好的铁片，

pairs.target: biānyán qiǎn cáo zài xié guāng lǐ xì dé xiàng tóufa .
pairs.english: the shallow grooves along their edges as fine as hair in the slanting light.
pairs.hanzi: 边沿浅槽在斜光里细得像头发。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī zhèng zhújiàn kàn jiēchùmiàn ,
pairs.english: Instructor Vey was examining each contact surface.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师正逐件看接触面，

pairs.target: luò héng fùzé bǎ xiǎo mù bǎi guàdào jiàshàng ,
pairs.english: Lohen was responsible for hanging the little wooden pendulum on its frame;
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡负责把小木摆挂到架上，

pairs.target: bǎi guò zhōngjiān shí , huì pèng yíxià báo mù shé .
pairs.english: as it swung through the middle, it would tap a thin wooden tongue.
pairs.hanzi: 摆过中间时，会碰一下薄木舌。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yǐjīng bǎ liǎngfēngxìn jìchū .
pairs.english: Tavi had already posted both letters.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维已经把两封信寄出。

pairs.target: nà zhīhòu de kè zhàocháng shàng ,
pairs.english: Classes since then had continued as usual,
pairs.hanzi: 那之后的课照常上，

pairs.target: chīfàn , xǐyī , rèn tú shàng de zì , yě zhàocháng zuò .
pairs.english: as had meals, laundry, and learning the words on drawings.
pairs.hanzi: 吃饭、洗衣、认图上的字，也照常做。

pairs.target: kě jīntiān yí jìn zhǔnbèi shì , tā háishì xiān kàn xiàng nàge xiǎo bǎi .
pairs.english: But today, as soon as he entered the preparation room, he still looked first toward the little pendulum.
pairs.hanzi: 可今天一进准备室，他还是先看向那个小摆。

pairs.target: shàng yícì rènzhēn liàn tuōshǒu liú chí , yǐjīng shì sāntiān qián .
pairs.english: His last serious practice at retaining an effect after release had been three days ago.
pairs.hanzi: 上一次认真练脱手留持，已经是三天前。

pairs.target: zài wǎngqián háiyǒu liǎnghuí , yǒu yìhuí shénme yě méi liúxià ,
pairs.english: There had been two attempts before that: one left nothing,
pairs.hanzi: 再往前还有两回，有一回什么也没留下，

pairs.target: yǒu yìhuí zhī tíng le jíduǎn de yíshùn .
pairs.english: and one lasted only the briefest instant.
pairs.hanzi: 有一回只停了极短的一瞬。

pairs.target: tā yuèláiyuè néng fēnqīng , shǒulǐ chēng dé wěn ,
pairs.english: He was increasingly able to tell the difference between holding it steady in his hands
pairs.hanzi: 他越来越能分清，手里撑得稳，

pairs.target: hé lí shǒu yǐhòu hái néng liúzhù , bìng búshì tóng yíjiàn shì .
pairs.english: and keeping it there once his hands had left: they were not the same thing.
pairs.hanzi: 和离手以后还能留住，并不是同一件事。

pairs.target: ài kē bǎ qiānbǐ háigěi tā , jiào tā zài zhǐ shàng xiān xiě jīntiān de rìqī .
pairs.english: Eko returned his pencil and told him to put today's date on the paper first.
pairs.hanzi: 艾珂把铅笔还给他，叫他在纸上先写今天的日期。

pairs.target: tā kàn le yìyǎn nà liǎngtiáo jìlù lán , wèn wèishénme dìèrtiáo liú dé nàme zhǎi .
pairs.english: She glanced at the two recording rows and asked why the second was so narrow.
pairs.hanzi: 她看了一眼那两条记录栏，问为什么第二条留得那么窄。

pairs.target: " xiǎngzhe dìyītiáo huì xiě dé duō . "
pairs.english: “I thought I'd have more to write in the first.”
pairs.hanzi: “想着第一条会写得多。”

pairs.target: " nà yě bié xiān bǎ dìèrtiáo èsǐ . "
pairs.english: “Don't starve the second one in advance, either.”
pairs.hanzi: “那也别先把第二条饿死。”

pairs.target: tā bǎ zhǐ zhuǎnguò lái , tì tā huà le liǎngtiáo yíyàng cháng de xiàn .
pairs.english: She turned the paper around and drew him two lines of equal length.
pairs.hanzi: 她把纸转过来，替他画了两条一样长的线。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào le yíxià , jǐnzhāng què méiyǒu xiāoshī .
pairs.english: Tavi smiled briefly, but his nerves did not disappear.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑了一下，紧张却没有消失。

pairs.target: jīntiān yòng de réng shì nàzhǒng xiǎo tiěpiàn ,
pairs.english: Today they were still using the same kind of small iron plates.
pairs.hanzi: 今天用的仍是那种小铁片，

pairs.target: zhěngkuài de liáng pèi guò , liǎngbiān de jiēchùqū dōu chóngxīn jiǎnchá .
pairs.english: Their total volumes were matched, and both contact areas had been checked again.
pairs.hanzi: 整块的量配过，两边的接触区都重新检查。

pairs.target: měipiàn qiánduān zhǐyǒu hěn qīng de gùdìng fùzài , dǐxià yǒu dǎng kuài ,
pairs.english: Each plate carried only a very light fixed load at the front, with a stop beneath it.
pairs.hanzi: 每片前端只有很轻的固定负载，底下有挡块，

pairs.target: zhǐzhēn zài kèxiàn biān tíng zhe , shuí pèng le jiàzi dōu kàndéchūlái .
pairs.english: The pointers rested beside the scale marks; anyone touching the frame would be obvious.
pairs.hanzi: 指针在刻线边停着，谁碰了架子都看得出来。

pairs.target: lǎoshī míngquè shuō , xiān zuò yícì , kàn wán zài juédìng dìèrcì .
pairs.english: The teacher said clearly: one attempt first, then they would review it before deciding on a second.
pairs.hanzi: 老师明确说，先做一次，看完再决定第二次。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuāngshǒu luòxiàqù shí , tiě shì liáng de .
pairs.english: The iron was cold when Tavi set both hands down.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维双手落下去时，铁是凉的。

pairs.target: tā xiān děng nà céng liángyì guòqù , cái mànmàn bǎ liǎngbiān de biànhuà jiē qǐlái .
pairs.english: He waited for that sensation of cold to pass, then slowly linked the changes on both sides.
pairs.hanzi: 他先等那层凉意过去，才慢慢把两边的变化接起来。

pairs.target: zhǐzhēn piān kāi yìdiǎn , tíngzhù .
pairs.english: The pointers shifted a little and stopped.
pairs.hanzi: 指针偏开一点，停住。

pairs.target: mù bǎi cóng yǎnjiǎo huàng guòqù , xiǎng le yíxià .
pairs.english: The pendulum swung through the corner of his vision and clicked once.
pairs.hanzi: 木摆从眼角晃过去，响了一下。

pairs.target: tā tīng dé tài rènzhēn , táishǒu fǎnér jí le .
pairs.english: Listening too intently made him lift his hands in a rush instead.
pairs.hanzi: 他听得太认真，抬手反而急了。

pairs.target: yòushǒu xiān líkāi , zuǒshǒu hái cèng zhe biān .
pairs.english: His right hand came away first while his left still brushed the edge.
pairs.hanzi: 右手先离开，左手还蹭着边。

pairs.target: liǎnggēn zhǐzhēn jīhū yìqǐ huíqù , luò héng zhī láidejí xiě yígè qǐdiǎn .
pairs.english: Both pointers returned almost together; Lohen only had time to record a starting point.
pairs.hanzi: 两根指针几乎一起回去，洛衡只来得及写一个起点。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi méi shuō zìjǐ qíshí kuài chénggōng le .
pairs.english: Tavi did not say he had actually nearly succeeded.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维没说自己其实快成功了。

pairs.target: tā kànjiàn le zuǒshǒu hái méi líkāi de nà yìxiǎo jié , hènbùdé bǎ gāngcái dǎohuíqù chóng lái .
pairs.english: He had seen that brief interval when his left hand was still touching, and longed to rewind the moment and try again.
pairs.hanzi: 他看见了左手还没离开的那一小截，恨不得把刚才倒回去重来。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī bǎ mù bǎi tíngzhù , ràng tā lí zhuō .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey stopped the pendulum and had him leave the table.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师把木摆停住，让他离桌。

pairs.target: ài kē dì lái shuǐ , tā hē dé tài kuài , bēi yán zhuàng le yíxià yá .
pairs.english: Eko handed him water; he drank too quickly and knocked the rim against his teeth.
pairs.hanzi: 艾珂递来水，他喝得太快，杯沿撞了一下牙。

pairs.target: tā jiǎzhuāng méi kànjiàn , zhuǎntóu qù bāng lìng yìzhuō tiáo dèngzǐ .
pairs.english: She pretended not to notice and turned to help adjust a stool at another table.
pairs.hanzi: 她假装没看见，转头去帮另一桌调凳子。

pairs.target: luò héng guòlái , bǎ zhǐ gěi tā kàn .
pairs.english: Lohen came over and showed him the paper.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡过来，把纸给他看。

pairs.target: shàngmiàn méiyǒu xiě shībài , zhī jì le liǎngshǒu líkāi de xiānhòu .
pairs.english: It did not say “failure,” only which hand had left first.
pairs.hanzi: 上面没有写失败，只记了两手离开的先后。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kàn wán shuō kěyǐ xiě shībài , běnlái jiùshì .
pairs.english: After reading it, Tavi said he could write “failure”; that was what it was.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看完说可以写失败，本来就是。

pairs.target: luò héng shuō tā hái méi xiě wán , jiào tā biétì zìjǐ ānpái měigè zì .
pairs.english: Lohen said he hadn't finished writing, and told him not to arrange every word for him.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡说他还没写完，叫他别替自己安排每个字。

pairs.target: tāmen zuò le yíhuìer .

pairs.hanzi: 他们坐了一会儿。

pairs.target: gébì zhuō yǒurén qīngqīng huānhū , yòu mǎshàng yādī le shēngyīn .

pairs.target: tǎ wéi hěn xiǎng kàn shì shuí , zuìhòu háishì zhuǎnguò tóu ,

pairs.hanzi: 塔维很想看是谁，最后还是转过头，

pairs.target: kànjiàn yígè píngshí bùzěnme shuōhuà de nǚhái zhèng wò zhe zìjǐ de shǒu , xiào dé jiānbǎng dōu táiqǐ lái le .
pairs.english: He saw a usually quiet girl clasping her own hands, smiling so much her shoulders rose.
pairs.hanzi: 看见一个平时不怎么说话的女孩正握着自己的手，笑得肩膀都抬起来了。

pairs.target: tā yě gēnzhe xiào le .
pairs.english: He found himself smiling too.
pairs.hanzi: 他也跟着笑了。

pairs.target: yuánlái zhè jiān wūzilǐ , děng zhe nà yìxiǎo huìer de rén bùzhǐ tā yígè .
pairs.english: So he wasn't the only person in this room waiting for that little stretch of time.
pairs.hanzi: 原来这间屋子里，等着那一小会儿的人不止他一个。

pairs.target: dìèrcì kāishǐ qián , lǎoshī wèn tā de zhǐjiān yǒuméiyǒu má .
pairs.english: Before the second attempt, the teacher asked whether his fingertips were numb.
pairs.hanzi: 第二次开始前，老师问他的指尖有没有麻。

pairs.target: tā zhúgè pèng le pèng , yáotóu , yòu shuō yǎnjīng yǒudiǎnlèi .
pairs.english: He touched them one by one and shook his head, then said his eyes were a little tired.
pairs.hanzi: 他逐个碰了碰，摇头，又说眼睛有点累。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī bǎ yǐzi nuó jìn , ràng tā búyòng dītóu tiēzhe chǐ ,
pairs.english: Instructor Vey moved the chair closer so he would not have to bend down toward the scale,
pairs.hanzi: 维老师把椅子挪近，让他不用低头贴着尺，

pairs.target: bìng shuō zhè yìhuí yǐhòu jiéshù .
pairs.english: and said they would finish after this attempt.
pairs.hanzi: 并说这一回以后结束。

pairs.target: tā zài bǎshǒu fàngshàngqù , méiyǒu qù zhuī mù bǎi de shēngyīn .
pairs.english: He set his hands down again without chasing the sound of the pendulum.
pairs.hanzi: 他再把手放上去，没有去追木摆的声音。

pairs.target: liǎngbiān wěnzhù hòu , tā ràng zhǎng gēn hé zhǐ fù yìqǐ sōngkāi ,
pairs.english: Once both sides were steady, he released the heels of his hands and his fingertips together,
pairs.hanzi: 两边稳住后，他让掌根和指腹一起松开，

pairs.target: xiàng cóng zhuōshàng ná qǐ liǎngzhāng bùnéng juàn biān de zhǐ .
pairs.english: as though lifting two sheets of paper from a table without curling their edges.
pairs.hanzi: 像从桌上拿起两张不能卷边的纸。

pairs.target: shǒu líkāi le .
pairs.english: His hands came away.
pairs.hanzi: 手离开了。

pairs.target: zhǐzhēn méiyǒu lìkè huíqù .
pairs.english: The pointers did not immediately return.
pairs.hanzi: 指针没有立刻回去。

pairs.target: nà yíxià , tǎ wéi juéde wūlǐ suǒyǒurén dōu tíng le .
pairs.english: For that instant, Tavi felt as though everyone in the room had stopped.
pairs.hanzi: 那一下，塔维觉得屋里所有人都停了。

pairs.target: qíshí ài kē hái zài zǒu , gébì háiyǒu shuǐshēng , mù bǎi yě méiyǒu chíyí .
pairs.english: In fact Eko was still walking, water still sounded next door, and the pendulum had not hesitated either.
pairs.hanzi: 其实艾珂还在走，隔壁还有水声，木摆也没有迟疑。

pairs.target: tā chuānguò zhōngjiān , qīngqīng xiǎng le yícì .
pairs.english: It passed through the middle and clicked softly once.
pairs.hanzi: 它穿过中间，轻轻响了一次。

pairs.target: tā kànzhe zìjǐ de liǎngzhīshǒu , zhǎngxīn kōng zhe , zhuōshàng de biànhuà què hái zài nàlǐ .
pairs.english: He looked at his two hands: his palms were empty, yet the change remained there on the table.
pairs.hanzi: 他看着自己的两只手，掌心空着，桌上的变化却还在那里。

pairs.target: búshì kào tā yònglì ànzhe , yě búshì shuí tì tā tuōzhù .
pairs.english: It was not because he was pressing hard, nor was anyone else supporting it for him.
pairs.hanzi: 不是靠他用力按着，也不是谁替他托住。

pairs.target: nàge yóu tā zuò chūlái de xiǎoxiǎo chābié , zànshí líkāi le tā de shēntǐ .
pairs.english: That small difference he had made existed, for the moment, apart from his body.
pairs.hanzi: 那个由他做出来的小小差别，暂时离开了他的身体。

alignment.english: existed, for the moment, apart from

pairs.target: mù shé yòu xiǎng .
pairs.english: The wooden tongue clicked again.
pairs.hanzi: 木舌又响。

pairs.target: " xiànzài huílái . " wéi lǎoshī shuō .
pairs.english: “Come back now,” Instructor Vey said.
pairs.hanzi: “现在回来。”维老师说。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuāngshǒu tóngshí tiē huí yuánchù , zhào liàn guò de cìxù jiěkāi .
pairs.english: Tavi placed both hands back on their original spots together and undid the effect in the practiced order.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维双手同时贴回原处，照练过的次序解开。

pairs.target: liǎnggēn zhǐzhēn wǎng gèzì yuánlái de wèizhì luò , méiyǒu zhuàng dào dǎng kuài .
pairs.english: Both pointers dropped toward their original positions without striking the stops.
pairs.hanzi: 两根指针往各自原来的位置落，没有撞到挡块。

pairs.target: tāmen tíngxià yǐhòu , tā réng bùgǎn xiān xiào , táitóu kàn lǎoshī .
pairs.english: Even after they stopped, he did not dare smile first; he looked up at the teacher.
pairs.hanzi: 它们停下以后，他仍不敢先笑，抬头看老师。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī kàn le lìngyìbiān de jìlù , diǎntóu ,
pairs.english: Instructor Vey checked the record on the other side and nodded.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师看了另一边的记录，点头，

pairs.target: shuō zhècì kànqīng le , guò le liǎngshēng , huí chù jiěchú yě zuòdào le .
pairs.english: She said this time they had seen clearly: it had lasted past two clicks, and he had also cancelled it by touching again.
pairs.hanzi: 说这次看清了，过了两声，回触解除也做到了。

pairs.target: jīntiān búzài shì .
pairs.english: No more attempts today.
pairs.hanzi: 今天不再试。

pairs.target: tā zhè cái sōngkāi zuǐjiǎo , fāxiànzìjǐ yáchǐ yìzhí yǎo zhe .
pairs.english: Only then did he let the corners of his mouth relax, discovering he had been clenching his teeth all along.
pairs.hanzi: 他这才松开嘴角，发现自己牙齿一直咬着。

alignment.english: let the corners of his mouth relax

pairs.target: luò héng dītóu xiě dé hěnkuài , xiě wán bǎ zhǐ zhuǎngěi tā .
pairs.english: Lohen wrote quickly with his head down, then turned the paper for him.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡低头写得很快，写完把纸转给他。

pairs.target: nàtiáo xiānqián chàdiǎn huà zhǎi de lán , dǎo méi zhàn duōshǎo zì .
pairs.english: The row he had nearly drawn too narrow earlier did not take many words after all.
pairs.hanzi: 那条先前差点画窄的栏，倒没占多少字。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dú le liǎngbiàn , shēnshǒu xiǎng pèng tiěpiàn , yòu shōuhuí lái , zhuǎnér mōlemō zhǐbiān .
pairs.english: Tavi read it twice, reached toward the plates, then withdrew his hand and touched the paper's edge instead.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维读了两遍，伸手想碰铁片，又收回来，转而摸了摸纸边。

pairs.target: ài kē wèn tā shìbushì yào bǎ zhè zhāng yě zhuāngjìn hézi , tā shuō dāngrán .
pairs.english: Eko asked whether he would put this sheet in his box too. He said, of course.
pairs.hanzi: 艾珂问他是不是要把这张也装进盒子，他说当然。

pairs.target: tā shuō nà dé bǎ hézi shōu zhěngqí , bùrán yǐhòu xiān xuéhuì de shì jiè dìfāng fàng zhǐ .
pairs.english: She said he had better tidy the box, or the first thing he learned would be borrowing space for paper.
